workspaceTools.title: Browse all modules

workspaceTools.title: Gallery
workspaceTools.description: Save selected recipes in local browser storage.

workspaceTools.description: Review session history and undo prior changes.

workspaceTools.title: Record
workspaceTools.description: Capture clips of supported living plates.

workspaceTools.title: Science report
workspaceTools.description: Read the technique’s registered evidence and its limitations.

workspaceTools.title: Ambient
workspaceTools.description: Walk through techniques on a 30 second timer with fresh seeds.

workspaceTools.title: Focus
workspaceTools.description: Hide workspace controls to view the plate.
